Extracts the river network as a raster: the cells whose total contributing area exceeds a threshold, optionally combined with the slope or the topographic classes.

**Toolbox folder:** Network<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Network, Channels, Total contributing area, Threshold<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.ExtractNetwork`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inTca` | raster file |  |  | The map of the total contributing areas. |
| `inFlow` | raster file |  |  | The map of the drainage directions, needed in the modes with slope or topographic classes. |
| `inSlope` | raster file |  |  | The optional map of slope. |
| `inTc3` | raster file |  |  | The optional map of aggregated topographic classes. |
| `pThres` | int |  | `0` | The threshold for a cell to be part of the network. In the only tca mode it is the minimum total contributing area, in number of cells: lower values give a denser network. |
| `pMode` | String |  | `only tca` | The criterion for the network cells. Allowed values: `only tca`, `tca and slope`, `tca in convergent sites`. |
| `pExp` | double |  | `0.5` | Exponent of the total contributing area in the modes with slope or topographic classes. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outNet` | output file |  | The extracted network raster. |
